questions.question: Civil rights in a country are enjoyed by ________.
Which of the following is NOT a fundamental human right under the Nigerian Constitution?
A citizen's freedom of movement may be restrained if he or she ________.
options: A. Refuses to salute the Head of State
C. Refuses to vote at elections
D. Has been convicted by a court

questions.question: Fundamental human rights can broadly be grouped into how many generations?
The rights to own property and operate lawful businesses are categorized as ________ rights.
Human rights violations can lead to ________.
Crisis in society can best be resolved through ________.
Which category of rights is commonly regarded as third-generation rights?
The statutory responsibility of the military is to defend the territorial borders of the country against ________ aggression.
In a presidential system, the power to exercise administrative functions rests mainly with the ________.
The following are ancient sources that discussed people's rights and responsibilities before the UDHR EXCEPT ________.
The public service of a nation belongs mainly to which arm of government?
The political culture of a people can be acquired through ________.
The following factors threaten the existence of human rights EXCEPT ________.
Which category of rights falls within first-generation rights?
Eleanor Roosevelt headed the committee that drafted which of the following documents?
options: C. Universal Declaration of Human Rights

questions.question: Fundamental human rights are contained in which part of the 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria?
Which of these international organizations was established in 1945?
After the First World War, which organization was created to promote international peace and cooperation?
Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of the rule of law?
options: A. Adherence to human rights principles

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of orderliness in society?
The following are examples of civil society organizations EXCEPT ________.
Working together towards achieving a common goal is called ________.
The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles is called ________.
The right to life belongs to the category of ________ rights.
The symbol commonly used to differentiate political parties is the party ________.
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted in the year ________.
Which of the following can constitute a temporary limitation on some fundamental human rights?
Which of the following can serve as a unifying factor in Nigeria?
The involvement of citizens in the electoral process of a nation is referred to as ________.
Which of these societal values is most expected of every public office holder?

Use the dialogue below to answer the question.

Aminu: This time last year, I was in Chief Jeunkoku's mansion, eating, drinking and dancing to the music of a popular musician to celebrate the New Year.
Bello: So, why was there no party this New Year?
Aminu: The music has changed. Next month, Chief is to face the music for sharing in a big loot.

The phrase "the music has changed" refers to the fact that ________.
options: A. Checks and balances are no longer effective
B. Public servants are expected to show partisanship
C. There was corruption in the public service sector
D. The activities of the judiciary should be checkmated

questions.question: From the dialogue in Question 32, Aminu's first statement suggests that he was ________.
options: B. Jealous of Chief Jeunkoku's wealth
D. Discouraging injustice in the land

questions.question: From the dialogue in Question 32, Chief Jeunkoku may evade sanctions if there is ________.
options: A. Presence of checks and balances
B. Effective operation of the rule of law
D. A weak and compromised judiciary

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of civil society?
options: A. Protection of the interests of society

questions.question: The right to contest for public office falls under ________ rights.
Supervisory councillors at the local government level are part of the ________.
Politically enlightened people may still feel discouraged from participating in the political affairs of their society because of political ________.
Political participation is encouraged by the following reasons EXCEPT ________.
options: C. Enhancing the dividends of democracy
D. Influencing the direction of government policies

questions.question: A system of government in which ultimate political power resides with the people is called ________.
Political apathy can be caused by ________.
The constitutions of the Federal Republic of Nigeria from 1979 to 1999 have generally been ________.
Which of the following is a human rights advocacy organization?
The prevention of global warming falls mainly under which category of human rights?
The Nigerian Police Force is an example of a ________ institution.

Use the dialogue below to answer the question.

Mr. Gamba: Mr. Katoun, where are you going with a hoe and cutlass on a day that has been set aside for the rescheduled gubernatorial election in our state?
Mr. Katoun: I am going to the farm to harvest some tubers of yam for the next market day. I don't need to remind you that we have been made our own government. Therefore, the sale of this produce is much more beneficial to me and my family than whoever becomes the next government.

From the dialogue above, Mr. Katoun has demonstrated ________.
From the dialogue in Question 46, Mr. Gamba is involved in an essential community service as ________.
The behaviour of Mr. Katoun in Question 46 can be traced to the following factors EXCEPT ________.
options: A. Inadequate security at polling booths

questions.question: A gubernatorial election in a state is an election for the office of the ________.
options: D. Member of the House of Assembly

questions.question: How can citizens such as Mr. Katoun be encouraged to participate actively in elections?
options: C. Provide good leadership and governance
D. Help them harvest their crops on election day

essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer five (5) questions in this section. Write your answers clearly.

questions.question: Outline and explain three challenges facing human rights in the 21st century. (9 marks)
State and explain three characteristics of the civil service. (9 marks)
Discuss three classifications of the civil service. (9 marks)
Trace the evolution of human rights through the activities of the United Nations. (9 marks)
What are the shortcomings of the civil service? Explain three. (9 marks)

With relevant examples, discuss the following:
(a) First-generation rights
(b) Third-generation rights. (9 marks)
Itemize and explain three functions of the public service in Nigeria. (9 marks)
